description: Raise a decision card for a person (status pending) in the ledger in the repository folder set by the PLAINHUB_LEDGER environment variable (if not set, the folder the server was started in) (.agents/decisions/<id>.md). Use it when something needs a human choice, such as shipping a change, spending money or changing permissions; the person approves or rejects it in PlainHub. Writes the file only; run plainhub_ledger_sync to share it. Returns a link that opens it in PlainHub (on a phone too) once it is pushed, or what to do first if the repository is not on GitHub. Refuses if the id already exists. Example: {"id": "2026-10-08-ship-login-fix", "summary": "Ship the login fix?", "ref": ["fix-login-timeout"], "body": "- What changes: users stay signed in\n- Risk: small"}

body.description: Markdown body in the room language (.agents/room.md language:; English if not set) (max 4KB). Start a new paragraph with a blank line, or use a list ("- "); a single line break does not start a new line (as on GitHub).

id.description: Card id: lowercase letters and digits joined by - or ., e.g. 2026-10-08-ship-login-fix

ref.description: Branches, commits or threads this card is about

refs.description: Renamed to ref. Do not use (the card is not written)

summary.description: One line in the room language (.agents/room.md language:; English if not set), max 120 characters

name: plainhub_decide
